items.en: U.S. Strikes Iranian Rocket Launchers on Larak Island in First Attack on Iran Since July
items.zh: 美軍空襲荷莫茲海峽拉拉克島伊朗火箭發射器，7 月以來首次對伊朗動武
items.summary: U.S. Central Command said American forces struck two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz, weapons it said were operated by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. It is the first U.S. strike on Iranian territory since July and marks a sharp escalation in the Strait of Hormuz crisis. The strike came a day after a tanker transiting near Khasab, Oman, was hit by an unidentified projectile, according to UK Maritime Trade Operations. Roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne oil moves through the strait, so any sustained exchange there feeds directly into crude prices and shipping insurance costs.

items.en: Ferry Carrying 267 People Capsizes in Eastern Mediterranean on Cyprus–Turkey Crossing
items.zh: 賽普勒斯開往土耳其渡輪東地中海翻覆，267 人中 237 人獲救
items.summary: A passenger ferry sailing from Cyprus to Turkey capsized in the eastern Mediterranean carrying 259 passengers and eight crew. Rescuers pulled 237 people from the water, leaving roughly 30 unaccounted for as search operations continued into the night. The cause of the capsizing has not been established, and authorities have not said whether weather, overloading or a mechanical failure was involved. The incident is one of the deadliest maritime accidents in the region this year and has renewed scrutiny of safety inspections on short-haul eastern Mediterranean passenger routes.

items.en: Nepal Flash Flood Death Toll Climbs to 669 With More Than 2,400 Still Missing
items.zh: 尼泊爾暴洪死亡人數升至 669 人，逾 2,400 人失聯
items.summary: The death toll from flash floods across Nepal rose to 669, with more than 2,400 people still reported missing, making it one of the worst monsoon disasters in the country's recent history. Entire settlements in mountain valleys were swept away, and damaged roads and bridges have left rescue teams unable to reach several districts. Aid agencies warn the missing figure may translate into a far higher final death count once remote areas are searched. The disaster follows a monsoon season that has produced repeated extreme rainfall events across South Asia.

items.en: Niger's Army Retakes Airbase After Failed Coup Attempt in Niamey
items.zh: 尼日軍方奪回空軍基地，尼阿美政變企圖失敗
items.summary: Niger's army said it regained control of an airbase seized by mutinous soldiers, a day after state television confirmed that dissident elements of the armed forces had attempted a coup in the capital, Niamey. Attacks were reported on Diori Hamani International Airport and the Presidential Palace before loyalist units pushed the mutineers back. Niger has been ruled by a military government since the 2023 coup, and the latest unrest points to fractures inside the security forces. The Sahel has now seen repeated coups and counter-coups over the past three years.

items.en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Bishkek as 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit Opens
items.zh: 習近平抵達比什凱克，第 26 屆上海合作組織峰會今日登場
items.summary: Chinese leader Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan arrived in Bishkek for a state visit and the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit, which opened Monday. The summit coincides with Kyrgyzstan's Independence Day and the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Nomad Games. The SCO groups China, Russia, India, Iran, Pakistan and Central Asian states, and this year's agenda is dominated by regional security and trade corridors at a moment when the Strait of Hormuz crisis is disrupting energy flows that several member states depend on.

items.en: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Launches on Falcon Heavy in 'Glorious Dawn Launch'
items.zh: NASA 羅曼太空望遠鏡由獵鷹重型火箭送上太空，將獵捕暗物質與系外行星
items.summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope lifted off aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy from Kennedy Space Center at 7:26 a.m. EDT on Sunday and successfully separated from the second stage. Roman will investigate dark energy and dark matter, conduct a statistical census of planetary systems, and support a broad range of astrophysics research with a field of view roughly a hundred times wider than Hubble's. The telescope is named for NASA's first chief astronomer, known as the 'Mother of Hubble.' It is the agency's most significant new observatory since JWST.

items.en: ChatGPT Holds 53.9% of Chatbot Traffic, but Claude Is the Fastest-Growing at 9.2%
items.zh: AI 聊天機器人市佔：ChatGPT 53.9%、Gemini 27.9%、Claude 9.2% 但成長最快
items.summary: ChatGPT still leads the generative AI chatbot market with 53.9% of worldwide web visits across the seven largest assistants, ahead of Google Gemini at 27.9% and Anthropic's Claude at 9.2%. The more striking number is growth: Claude reached 952.6 million web visits, up roughly 855% year over year and 228% in a single quarter, the fastest expansion in the set. The gap between first and third remains large, but the trajectory suggests the market is becoming genuinely three-way rather than a single-vendor race, particularly in coding and agentic workflows.

items.en: HBM Memory Sold Out Through 2026 as Contract Prices Jump 20% Quarter on Quarter
items.zh: HBM 高頻寬記憶體 2026 年全年賣光，合約價單季再漲 20%
items.summary: High-bandwidth memory has become the binding constraint on AI infrastructure, with HBM supply sold out through 2026 and a total addressable market projected at $100 billion by 2028. HBM3e contract pricing rose roughly 20% quarter over quarter as SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron allocated 2026 capacity against already-booked AI accelerator demand. HBM4 is entering production this year, with 16-high stacks targeted for the fourth quarter and Samsung reporting speeds up to 13 Gb/s per pin. Gaming GPUs are being squeezed out as capacity shifts to data centre customers.

items.en: US Open Opens at Flushing Meadows With Alcaraz and Sabalenka Defending Titles
items.zh: 美網在法拉盛開打，阿卡拉茲與莎芭蓮卡衛冕出擊
items.summary: The 2026 US Open began Sunday at the Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in Flushing Meadows, Queens, running through the men's final on September 13. Carlos Alcaraz and Aryna Sabalenka return as defending champions, with both singles draws opening across Sunday and Monday. The tournament is the last Grand Slam of the season and typically decides year-end ranking positions. Night sessions on Arthur Ashe Stadium again anchor the schedule, with first-round play spread over two days to accommodate the expanded 15-day format.

items.en: Germany Beat Spain 1–0 to Win Fourth Men's FIH Hockey World Cup Title
items.zh: 德國 1:0 擊敗西班牙，第四度捧起男子曲棍球世界盃
items.summary: Germany defeated Spain 1–0 in the final of the 2026 Men's FIH Hockey World Cup to secure their fourth world title, in a tight, low-scoring decider settled by a single goal. The result caps a tournament in which Germany's defensive structure proved decisive rather than their attacking output. A day earlier, Argentina won the Women's World Cup, beating the Netherlands on penalties after a 1–1 draw to claim their third title. The two finals mean the sport's biggest trophies now sit in Europe and South America respectively.

items.en: Hrgovic Stops Itauma in Ninth to Become Croatia's First Heavyweight World Champion
items.zh: 赫爾戈維奇第九回合 TKO 伊陶馬，成為克羅埃西亞首位重量級世界拳王
items.summary: Filip Hrgovic defeated Moses Itauma by ninth-round stoppage to win the vacant IBF heavyweight title, becoming the first Croatian heavyweight world champion in boxing history. The result is a significant upset given Itauma's status as one of the division's most hyped young prospects, and it reshapes the heavyweight picture heading into the autumn. Hrgovic, long regarded as a technically sound but underrated contender, had been waiting years for a title shot after a mandatory position that repeatedly failed to materialise.

items.en: Both Too Little and Too Much Sleep Linked to Faster Biological Ageing Across the Body
items.zh: 睡太少與睡太多都會加速生理老化，最佳區間落在 6.4–7.8 小時
items.summary: Researchers analysing 23 separate biological ageing clocks found that both short and long sleep durations were associated with faster ageing across multiple organ systems, with the lowest ageing levels among people sleeping roughly 6.4 to 7.8 hours per night. The U-shaped relationship suggests that oversleeping is not simply harmless compensation for sleep debt but carries its own measurable cost. The finding matters for students, who often swing between severe restriction during term and long recovery sleep afterwards, a pattern the data suggests may be worse than a stable schedule.

items.en: Brain Scans Show Schizophrenia Involves Widespread Synapse Loss, Worst on the Left Side
items.zh: 腦部掃描顯示思覺失調症伴隨大範圍突觸流失，左腦受損最嚴重
items.summary: Specialised brain imaging has shown that schizophrenia is linked to widespread loss of the synapses connecting brain cells, with the left hemisphere affected especially severely. The asymmetry is notable because the left hemisphere carries most language processing, which may help explain the disordered speech and thought patterns characteristic of the condition. The work moves schizophrenia research further away from purely neurotransmitter-based models toward structural connectivity, and could eventually support imaging-based diagnosis rather than diagnosis by symptom checklist alone.

items.en: Childhood Criticism Leaves a Lasting Fear of Failure — but the Pattern Is More Flexible Than Assumed
items.zh: 童年被嚴厲批評會留下長期的失敗恐懼，但研究顯示這個模式可以改變
items.summary: New research published in mid-August finds that people who experienced frequent criticism in childhood carry a heightened fear of failure well into adulthood, shaping how they approach risk, feedback and achievement. The more useful part of the finding is that these emotional patterns appear surprisingly flexible: they respond to changes in current environment and to targeted intervention rather than being fixed traits. For students, that suggests perfectionism and avoidance around graded work are treatable habits rather than permanent personality features.

items.en: Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.5 Land Within Weeks in Summer 2026 Model Wave
items.zh: Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.5 密集落地，2026 夏季模型戰進入白熱化
items.summary: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google all shipped next-generation models this summer. Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, its fourth model in under two months after Mythos 5, Fable 5 and Sonnet 5; OpenAI rolled out GPT-5.5 Instant Mini in ChatGPT on July 6 and added a $125-per-month premium ChatGPT Business seat on August 11 aimed at users hitting agent-workflow caps; Google shipped Gemini 3.5 Transcribe as two separate speech-to-text endpoints. The release cadence has compressed from roughly annual to roughly monthly across all three labs.

items.en: Nvidia Beats on Earnings and Guidance; Rubin R100 Confirmed on 3nm With HBM4
items.zh: 輝達財報與財測雙優，Rubin R100 確認採 3nm 搭 HBM4、Feynman 上台積電 A16
items.summary: Nvidia's quarterly results and forward guidance came in above Wall Street expectations, lifting the Nasdaq 1.6% on Thursday before Friday's pullback. On the roadmap, Rubin R100 is expected on a 3nm process paired with HBM4, while Feynman — targeted for 2028 — is reportedly built on TSMC's A16 node, which would make it Nvidia's first mass-produced chip on a 1nm-class process. Nvidia and SK Hynix, which holds roughly 58% of global HBM share, have also formalised a multi-year partnership around the Vera Rubin platform.

items.en: UMC Raises Capex to $2bn and Launches $1.8bn Convertible Bond to Fund Silicon Photonics Push
items.zh: 聯電上調資本支出至 20 億美元、發行 18 億美元海外可轉債，押注矽光子與先進封裝
items.summary: United Microelectronics' board approved an overseas unsecured convertible bond of up to $1.8 billion to fund capacity expansion and deepen its specialty process portfolio. The company expects 12-inch utilisation to return above 90% in the third quarter and has raised 2026 capital expenditure to $2 billion, targeting silicon photonics and advanced packaging with a goal of surpassing $1 billion in AI-related revenue within three years. UMC shares hit limit-up at NT$130 on Friday on turnover of NT$38.3 billion, the highest of any Taiwanese listed stock that day.

items.en: King Gnu CEN+RAL Tour 2026 — Largest Tour Yet, With Taipei, Hong Kong and Bangkok Legs
items.zh: King Gnu 生涯最大規模巡演，台北／香港／曼谷場次已於今年上半年結束
items.summary: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026, the band's largest tour to date, ran across 15 cities including first-ever shows in Niigata, Bangkok and Hong Kong. The Asian leg took in Bangkok on May 23, Hong Kong on May 29–30, Taipei on June 6–7, plus Shanghai and Seoul. Those dates have already passed, so the Taiwan and Hong Kong opportunities for this cycle are closed; watch the official Sony Music page and CLUB GNU fan club for any autumn additional dates or a filmed release of the tour.

items.en: LiSA Marks 15th Solo Anniversary With Largest Overseas Run — Taiwan and Hong Kong Included
items.zh: LiSA solo 出道 15 週年，生涯最大規模海外巡演含台灣與香港場
items.summary: LiSA is marking her 15th anniversary as a solo artist with the largest overseas run of her career: an Asia tour taking in Malaysia, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Korea, followed by her first-ever headline shows in Europe and the UK. This is the item on the watchlist most worth acting on, because Taiwan and Hong Kong dates are still upcoming rather than already played. Specific venues and on-sale dates had not been confirmed in the sources checked, so watch her official site and the local promoter announcements for ticket timing.

items.en: YOASOBI Announce Asia Dome and Stadium Tour From October, Including Singapore National Stadium
items.zh: YOASOBI 十月起亞洲巨蛋／體育場巡演，含新加坡國家體育場單場
items.summary: YOASOBI have announced an Asia dome and stadium tour beginning in October 2026, including a single show at Singapore National Stadium — a step up in venue scale from their previous arena-level Asian runs. Separately, the duo launched a Taco Bell collaboration in Japan from August 14 with a limited-time 'Y-BURRITO' menu item. Taiwan and Hong Kong dates were not listed in the announcements checked; given the tour opens in October, any additional Asian cities would likely be revealed within the next few weeks.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Set Autumn Fan Club Tour 'SHADOWS' After Summer Tour Wrap
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 夏季巡演落幕，秋季接續舉辦 FC 巡迴「SHADOWS」
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE closed their 'ゼンジン未到とイ/ミュータブル〜間奏編〜' tour on July 5 and have lined up an autumn fan club tour titled 'SHADOWS' (リンゴジャム). Fan club tours are typically Japan-only and ballot-entry, so overseas fans generally cannot buy in directly; the practical route is CLUB fan club membership plus a Japan trip. The band also appeared at MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026 in Odaiba, footage from which went to worldwide streaming on August 14.

items.en: MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026 Goes to Worldwide Streaming With Fujii Kaze and Mrs. GREEN APPLE Performances
items.zh: MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026 全球串流上線，藤井風與 Mrs. GREEN APPLE 等 28 組登場
items.summary: Footage from MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026, held in Tokyo's Odaiba district, began worldwide streaming on August 14, with newly shot on-site photography of all 28 performing acts including Fujii Kaze, Mrs. GREEN APPLE and M!LK. Nominated works this year spanned much of the watchlist: Fujii Kaze, YOASOBI, Mrs. GREEN APPLE, Vaundy's 'Odoriko', tuki.'s 'Bansanka' and Aimer's 'Zankyou Sanka'. For anyone tracking these artists, the stream is the single most efficient way to catch current live form in one sitting.

market.asOf: 台股 2026/08/28（週五）收盤 · 美股 2026/08/28（週五）收盤 —— 今天 8/31（一）台股 09:00 已開盤、美股台北時間今晚 21:30 開盤；加密貨幣與黃金為 8/30 前後近即時報價
market.note: ★ 上週五（8/28）台美兩邊走出完全相反的方向，而且原因不同。　【台股 8/28】加權指數收 46,331.45 點、大漲 356.23 點（+0.77%），成交金額放大到 1 兆 230.44 億元（前一交易日不到 8,000 億），三大法人同步買超合計 468.17 億元（外資及陸資 415.88 億、投信 9.59 億、自營商 42.7 億）。這是「量價齊揚＋法人同買」的健康型上漲，不是靠幾檔權值股拉出來的。上市漲停 19 檔、上櫃漲停 17 檔，是這波以來家數最多的一天。　推力有三個：① 輝達 8/26 盤後財報與財測雙優，直接強化 AI 伺服器、散熱、PCB、半導體供應鏈的想像 ② 蘋果秋季發表會逼近，首款摺疊 iPhone 題材升溫，帶動光學與機構件 ③ MSCI 成分股調整今天（8/31）生效，南亞科與華邦電被納入全球標準指數，法人從 8/13 公布日起就一路卡位（南亞科被買超逾 9.3 萬張、華邦電逾 5.3 萬張）。　【美股 8/28】三大指數同步收黑但幅度都不大：那斯達克 26,402.42（-138.93、-0.52%）、S&P 500 7,711.76（-19.23、-0.25%）、道瓊 53,559.99（-9.45、-0.02%）。原因單一而明確：Fed 主席 Kevin Warsh 在 Jackson Hole 的首場主題演講被解讀為偏鷹，他直言通膨仍然太高、物價穩定將是 Fed 的首要任務，市場對「9 月升息」的押注一口氣跳到 57%。　注意這裡的措辭是「升息」不是「降息」——這是今年以來最大的政策風向轉變，如果 9 月真的升，高評價的成長股與槓桿類資產（加密相關、量子、太空）會是第一批被修理的。前一天（8/27）那斯達克才因為輝達財報大漲 1.6%、S&P 收在 7,730.99，週五等於把當週最後一段漲幅吐了一部分回去，但整週仍是收紅。
market.highlight: 🔭 這週先掌握這三件事：　① 【今天 8/31 生效】MSCI 全球標準指數台灣成分股調整正式生效 —— 南亞科（2408）與華邦電（2344）被納入。被動型基金必須在生效日買進，這通常會讓當天尾盤出現一段不看價格的買盤；但也要提醒：法人已經卡位兩週，「利多兌現」在生效日反轉的例子非常多，今天如果衝高不站穩反而要小心。　② 【9 月 FOMC】Fed 主席 Warsh 首場 Jackson Hole 演講已經把市場預期扭轉成「9 月升息機率 57%」。這是整個 9 月最大的變數，影響順序大致是：加密相關（COIN、MSTR、HOOD、CRCL）→ 量子（IONQ、QBTS、RGTI、QUBT）→ 太空（RKLB、ASTS）→ 高本益比軟體（PLTR、SNOW、NET）。你的觀察清單裡「很高風險」那一格全部落在這條線上。　③ 【記憶體是本波真正的主線】HBM 已經賣到 2026 年底完售、HBM3e 合約價單季再漲 20%，台股記憶體族群（南亞科 2408、華邦電 2344、旺宏 2337）與美股 MU 是同一個故事的兩端。這不是一日行情，但價格已經反映很多，追高請用小部位。　⚠️ 提醒：這份晨報距離上一份（8/25）中間隔了五個交易日，中間 8/26 輝達財報、8/27 Jackson Hole、8/28 MSCI 卡位這三件大事都發生在空窗期，你看到的數字是「五天累積後」的結果，不是單日變化。
